item.text: I’ll build a single solid from the four views, then compare the renders and refine the proportions before exporting the STEP file.

The first model is ready: a rectangular plate with two fork-shaped supports. I’ll check its orientation and proportions against the reference. You can follow it in the [CAD viewer](http://127.0.0.1:8771/#part.FCStd).
